command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
matrix_file <- args[[1]]
sample_file <- args[[2]]
variable_file <- args[[3]]
results_file <- args[[4]]
summary_file <- args[[5]]

stopifnot(as.character(getRversion()) >= "4.3.3")

dm <- read.delim(matrix_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 na.strings = c("NA", "NaN", "NAN", ""))
sm <- read.delim(sample_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 na.strings = c("NA", "NaN", "NAN", ""))
vm <- read.delim(variable_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 na.strings = c("NA", "NaN", "NAN", ""))

if (ncol(dm) < 2L) stop("Data matrix must contain sample IDs and at least one miRNA")
if (!all(c("sample", "group") %in% colnames(sm))) stop("Sample metadata must contain sample and group")
if (!("variable" %in% colnames(vm))) stop("Variable metadata must contain variable")
sample_ids <- as.character(dm[[1]])
variable_ids <- colnames(dm)[-1]
if (anyDuplicated(sample_ids)) stop("Duplicate sample IDs in data matrix")
if (anyDuplicated(variable_ids)) stop("Duplicate miRNA IDs in data matrix")
if (any(is.na(match(sample_ids, sm$sample)))) stop("Data-matrix samples do not all occur in sample metadata")
if (any(is.na(match(variable_ids, vm$variable)))) stop("Data-matrix variables do not all occur in variable metadata")
groups <- as.character(sm$group[match(sample_ids, sm$sample)])
if (!all(c("patient", "control") %in% groups)) stop("Both patient and control groups are required")

p_values <- rep(NA_real_, length(variable_ids))
mean_patient <- rep(NA_real_, length(variable_ids))
mean_control <- rep(NA_real_, length(variable_ids))
n_patient <- integer(length(variable_ids))
n_control <- integer(length(variable_ids))

for (j in seq_along(variable_ids)) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dm[[j + 1L]]))
  patient <- x[groups == "patient" & is.finite(x)]
  control <- x[groups == "control" & is.finite(x)]
  n_patient[[j]] <- length(patient)
  n_control[[j]] <- length(control)
  if (length(patient) > 0L) mean_patient[[j]] <- mean(patient)
  if (length(control) > 0L) mean_control[[j]] <- mean(control)
  if (length(patient) >= 2L && length(control) >= 2L) {
    p_values[[j]] <- tryCatch(
      stats::t.test(patient, control, alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  }
}

bonferroni <- stats::p.adjust(p_values, method = "bonferroni")
by <- stats::p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY")
results <- data.frame(
  variable = variable_ids,
  p_value = p_values,
  bonferroni_adjusted_p = bonferroni,
  BY_adjusted_p = by,
  n_patient = n_patient,
  n_control = n_control,
  mean_patient = mean_patient,
  mean_control = mean_control,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
write.table(results, results_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")

summary <- data.frame(
  method = c("Bonferroni", "Benjamini-Yekutieli"),
  n_miRNAs_tested = rep(sum(!is.na(p_values)), 2L),
  threshold = rep(0.05, 2L),
  n_significant = c(
    sum(!is.na(bonferroni) & bonferroni <= 0.05),
    sum(!is.na(by) & by <= 0.05)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary, summary_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
